name: Developer Agent
description: Picks the highest-priority task from tasks/, implements it, and marks it developed.

name: QA Agent
description: Tests the app with Puppeteer, researches improvements, creates new task files.

name: Task Prioritization Agent
description: Re-evaluates and re-orders task priorities based on current project state.

name: Code Reviewer Agent
description: Reviews code for SOLID principle violations and code reuse opportunities. Creates task files for findings.
